name: Sunway Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Sunway Real Estate Investment Trust (Sunway REIT or Trust) is one of the largest diversified real estate investment trusts (REITs) in Malaysia. It has a diverse portfolio strategically located across award-winning integrated townships in key locations in Greater Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Perak and Johor.
